messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hello

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: What screenshot count would you like me to provide?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For the feature graph, you'll be charged $45 extra.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I already have 11 screenshots from the phone. Could you bring the set to a total of 14? The 45 extra for the android graphic sounds good too.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Could we switch from hourly billing to a fixed fee for the whole project?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For iOS, the 14 Screenshots package costs $255. Adding $45 for the feature graph brings this to a single $300 contract.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: That price is too high, my friend. I paid $140 for the android screenshots, so my counteroffer is $185 total, including the $45 android graphic.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Sir, okay—the scope will be iOS only, with no iPad work. Please confirm that first, then send the contract.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Okay, I confirm that iPad is excluded, and I'm sending the contract now.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: okay great

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Work is now underway. Thanks!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Great! If any questions come up, please let me know.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hey Darian, please replace the image I am attaching here with the updated version above, 07-smart-filtering.png.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay Sir.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi Naveed,

Thank you for the ongoing collaboration! Here is the sequence for our next steps: after the first draft is delivered, we will set aside 4 business days to review and implement your feedback. As soon as you give final approval to that draft, I will begin the Feature Graph immediately.

I look forward to hearing your thoughts!
Best regards,
Darian

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Overall, this looks great, Darian. Please address the following comments:
1\. The first image works overall; however, the facial expressions look upset or sad. Please change them to something more suitable.
2\. At the top, remove the violence pill but retain nudity, kissing and profanity. The top photo currently shows active kissing, so please either hide it or use a photo that suggests kissing without actually showing it.
3, 4, 5: No changes are needed; they look good.
6\. Please replace this with something that communicates you can watch on any Google TV device.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: All of the requested changes are noted—thanks for the feedback. I'll implement them and send the updated screenshots soon.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The updated screenshots have been submitted for review. I'm now proceeding with the 1024x500 feature graph for the Play Store.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The feature graph has been submitted; please check it.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
The screenshots look great, thanks, Darian. For the graphic, please make these changes:
- Under the logo, add the phrase "Choose a Safer View".
- Replace the bottom text with "Smart safeguards that keep the whole household covered".

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay Sir

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please review this updated version for any remaining changes. If everything is fine, we can then proceed with delivery.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Everything looks great, Darian. One final change before delivery: center the Copper Finch logo over "Choose a Safer View", then proceed with delivery.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I've attached the zip containing the ready-to-upload PNGs. The Figma file is still being prepared, and I will send it in 12 hours.

Please approve the milestone.
Thanks.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I've attached the Figma File.

What do you think of my work? If possible, feedback with 5 stars would help me remain top rated. I'm always available for you here.
Thanks.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Everything has turned out great, Darian. Thank you for being so responsive throughout the work!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Now that everything is complete, would you please take a moment to end the contract?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I would also appreciate 5 stars, because a 5-star rating helps me stay successful and top rated on Upwork.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi Naveed,

I hope the final delivery of the Copper Finch screenshots meets your expectations. If you would like the Android screenshots updated using the same design, I can do that for $65.

Provided everything looks good, I’ll close out the contract. For any bugs, small tweaks or questions, I’ll remain available until Nov 22nd.

Thank you.
